dedupe_keys.name: consumption of diesel and petrol in india

description: Consumption of Diesel and Petrol in India is a dataset listed in KAPSARC Data Portal, an energy economics open data portal, published or maintained by King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center (KAPSARC). This dataset contains information about consumption of diesel and petrol in India for 1990-2019. Data from Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas. Coverage: as titled: Saudi Arabia, the Gulf states, India or the world (see the dataset page). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Conventional Fuels. Its keywords are Data Insight. The portal shows 2022-07-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy, water and transport system studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kapsarc-open-data-portal.
